name: LiveAvatar Launchpad
tagline: Opens ready-made avatar demos so you can try the product in one tap
description: A front door for people who have heard about LiveAvatar but never watched one work. Choose a ready scenario  -  a hostile investor tearing into your pitch, an interview rehearsal, a language tutor  -  and the session spins up at once. Newcomers land on a showcase; anyone returning can bend a demo toward their own case.
